about_page.label: About CDCAT
about_page.intro: CDCAT is a music database built for dedicated listeners.

highlights.archive_desc: CDCAT preserves music metadata that might otherwise disappear. This matters especially for independent and doujin releases whose circles and official sites may no longer exist.
highlights.timeline_desc: Record what you have heard and loved, build a lasting listening history, and share the artists and songs that matter to you.
highlights.creator_desc: Document standard, limited, made-to-order, hi-res, and download editions alongside store bonuses and official sales links, so listeners can understand and support each release.
highlights.developer_desc: CDCAT will provide a public API and documentation. Build lyric tools, cover matching, or your own applications on top of community-maintained data.
highlights.relations_desc: Connect music to games, anime, films, television, entries, and series so it can be explored from multiple perspectives.
highlights.community_desc: Beyond music metadata, CDCAT aims to welcome discussion of audio gear, physical media, digital releases, production techniques, and creative work.
highlights.stories_desc: Future features will connect interviews, booklet material, and contributed lyrics to help listeners understand how music is made.

about_page.guides_desc: Start here if you would like to help edit the database.
about_page.guide_basics_desc: Learn how contributions move through CDCAT.
about_page.guide_research_desc: What to look for before contributing metadata.
about_page.guide_submit_desc: Learn how CDCAT reviews music metadata.
about_page.community_desc: Discuss features, report issues, and meet other users.

home.hero_title: Find your coordinates in a sky full of sound
home.hero_description: CDCAT is a music database built for dedicated listeners.
home.database_desc: Look up detailed information about music releases.
home.timeline_desc: Keep track of the music you’ve heard and loved.
home.community_desc: Discuss music, audio gear, and composition.
home.search_example: Try: Touhou Koumakyou / Hatsune Miku / M3-53
home.for_everyone_desc: Whether you make music or simply love it, CDCAT has a place for you.
home.listener_desc: Track what you listen to, build playlists, and share the songs you love.
home.creator: Music creators
home.creator_desc: Showcase your releases, add store links, and hear from your listeners.
home.clean_data_desc: CDCAT does not scrape competing databases. Every record is submitted and maintained by the community.
home.beyond_music_desc: Music is often created alongside games, anime, films, and television. Rich relationships let you explore it from every angle.
home.topic_entry_title: Find every song from an anime
home.topic_entry_desc: Import anime and game entries from Bangumi.tv, then connect every related release in one place.
home.topic_series_title: Explore music across the same franchise
home.topic_series_desc: Bring games, anime, entries, and releases from the same IP into a clear, structured series.
home.collector_title: A music database made for collectors
home.collector_desc: Go beyond the album with detailed product editions and bonus items.
home.products_desc: See physical, limited, and digital editions together, with their relationships and prices.
home.bonuses_desc: Compare first-press, store-exclusive, download, and limited-time bonuses.
home.links_desc: Go directly to official and authorized stores without misleading redirects.
